intro.text: Common spren that appear around plants, especially just after highstorms. They look like motes of glowing green dust.

description.text: Now and then they appear in crowded places.
In the Cognitive Realm they look much the same, with tufts of white hair that ripple as they move.
With Stormlight and one of the Rhythms they can make plants grow faster. This drains Stormlight and can crack gemstones.
Singers see them with white spines and bond them to take mateform.
